title: Raw results route takes the StateInner lock on the async worker before spawn_blocking
outcome: get_test_run_results performs its inner.test_runs lookup on the blocking pool (run_blocking_api or inside the spawn_blocking closure), consistent with get_test_run, so a contended StateInner never blocks a tokio worker.
acceptance: Raw results route takes the StateInner lock on the async worker before spawn_blocking is done
